title: androsace elongata subsp. breistrofferi
intro: Androsace elongata subsp. breistrofferi, commonly known as Himalayan Androsace or Rock Jasmine, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the primrose family. It is native to the Himalayas and has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known to possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating digestive issues, wounds, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents present in Himalayan Androsace include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
